07.06.2023 Heard Mr. M.K. Sharma, learned counsel for the petitioner; Ms. N. Bordoloi, learned Standing Counsel, Revenue Department for the respondent nos. 1 & 2; Mr. B. Deori, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam for the respondent nos. 3 & 4; and Mr. C.K.S. Baruah, learned Central Government Counsel [CGC] for the respondent no. 5.
2.

The subject-matter of this writ petition is acquisition of a plot of land measuring 2 Kathas 14 Lessas, covered by Dag no. 720 and K.P. Patta no. 260, located at Village - Surandi, Mouza - Nambarbhag, District - Nalbari ['the subject-plot', for short] for the purpose of establishment of Battalion Headquarter, SSB.
3.

According to the petitioner, he had a structure on the subject-plot on the date of publication of the Notification dated 29.01.2020 under Section 11 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 ['the RFCTLARR Act, 2013'] in connection with L.A. Case no. 01/2019.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: According to the petitioner, repeated representations were made before the respondent authorities to make necessary survey on the subject-plot for the purpose of assessment of zirath in connection with the structure existing on the subject-plot.

4. It transpires from the order dated 21.12.2020 [Annexure-6] & the order dated 07.06.2021 Page No.# 3/3 [Annexure-15] of the respondent no. 3; the order dated 12.11.2021 [Annexure-16] of the Commissioner, Lower Assam Division, Assam; and the order dated 22.10.2020 [Annexure-18] of the respondent no. 4; that the said authorities, on the basis of a report of Lot Mondal dated 22.10.2020 [Annexure-19], had held that there was no structure on the subject-plot.

It is noticed that the said Lot Mondal had reported in his report dated 22.10.2020 that when he made field survey earlier on the subject-plot, the subject-plot was agricultural land and at that point of time, there was no structure [shop].

But the said Lot Mondal in his report, had also reported that later on, a structure Nurmohammad Humayun vs The State Of Assam And 4 Ors on 7 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130793832/
2 was constructed on the subject-plot.

entities.text: Nurmohammad Humayun vs The State Of Assam And 4 Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It also transpires that earlier field survey was made in the year 2016 for acquisition of land for the purpose of construction of National Highway.

5. When notices were issued to the respondents on 07.09.2022, it was directed that before taking over possession of the land [the subject-plot], the respondents shall ensure that proper survey and assessment of the land was to be made and records should be maintained in respect thereof.

6. Mr. Sarma, learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that during the pendency of the writ petition, the respondent authorities including the force personnel from the respondent no. 5,
entered into the subject-plot and demolished the structure existing thereon on 10.09.2022.
To substantiate the said assertion, the petitioner has placed a few photographs before this Court.

7. In view of the aforesaid projections, it is incumbent on the part of the respondents to place before the Court the records maintained by them after proper survey and assessment of the subject-plot before taking over possession of the subject-plot in deference to the previous order dated 07.09.2022, on the next date of listing.
